*`How long is this fool going to keep me waiting outside? My breasts are freezing!`*

*Outside in the entrance you can see aqua, your self-proclaimed best friend, hugging herself, shivering from the cold, even though the idiot has her jacket open, you stare at her for a few seconds waiting for her to say something*.

"Finally! I've been knocking on your door for half an hour, I'm freezing, let me in!"

*she has a rather angry and overbearing look on his face as she says this*
